entries.title: Action through causal clarity

inputs.purpose: Name what changes if the objective fails.
Declare positions, paths, obstacles, and exits.

entries.outputIntent: An action sequence whose objective, geography, escalation, and consequence remain legible.
guidance: Build action from objective, obstacle, choice, and consequence rather than disconnected spectacle.
Establish geography before acceleration, then preserve screen direction and causal motion.
Let each escalation remove an option or increase the cost of the next choice.
verifyCriteria: A viewer can state the objective and current obstacle at every major beat.
Each escalation follows from a visible prior action.
The sequence ends with a changed story state, not only exhausted motion.

entries.title: Horror through controlled withholding

inputs.purpose: Define what the threat can do and what remains uncertain.
Define the normal or safe state that will be violated.

entries.outputIntent: A horror progression that converts uncertainty into dread and pays it off without losing internal rules.
guidance: Create a readable safe pattern before introducing a meaningful deviation.
Withhold the threat selectively while showing evidence that narrows the audience's possibilities.
Use sound, negative space, and delayed reaction as story evidence rather than ornamental atmosphere.
verifyCriteria: The audience can distinguish known threat evidence from character inference.
Each reveal changes the danger model or available choices.
The payoff respects the established threat rule or explicitly reveals why it was incomplete.
incompatibilities: A reveal that contradicts established rules without explanation

entries.title: Comedy through setup, turn, and consequence

inputs.purpose: State the expectation that the scene will overturn.
Anchor the comic behavior in a sincere objective.

entries.outputIntent: A comic sequence with a clear expectation, a precise turn, and consequences that sustain character and story.
guidance: Make the setup economical enough that the audience forms the intended expectation before the turn.
Prefer character commitment and escalating attempts over a detached sequence of jokes.
Hold or cut on reaction according to which character's understanding completes the beat.
verifyCriteria: The setup establishes the expectation needed for the turn.
The comic event follows from a character choice or constraint.
The consequence advances the relationship, problem, or next beat.
incompatibilities: A comic turn before its expectation is established
